requests.reply: {"translations": ["New Hire Onboarding Guide", "Welcome to MoaLogis.", "This document guides you through what to do in order during your first two weeks ▶"]}
{"translations": ["For inquiries, please contact HR Manager Joonho Byun.", "Seojin Um will help you with the development environment setup.", "First day"]}
{"translations": ["When you arrive at work, first receive your access badge at the 1st floor information desk."]}

{"translations": ["Manager Junho Byeon will register the access badge you received.", "Your seat is next to the Dawn Team, and Seojin Eom will also sit in the same row.", "You will eat lunch with your team members"]}
{"translations": ["Day two", "On the second day, you will spend the entire day on-site.", "You will observe the unloading process while wearing safety shoes."]}
{"translations": ["Do not speak to drivers while they are working first."]}
{"translations": ["Submit the experience report to the team leader for approval.", "Once confirmed, it will be delivered to Manager Junho Jun.", "First week"]}

{"translations": ["MoaLogis new hires proceed through a task list called 'Launchpad' during their first week.", "Launchpad Task 1 is wiki login and joining the internal messenger.", "Company-wide announcements and small talk take place in the 'Hearth' channel."]}

{"translations": ["Step 2 is attending the fleet allocation system Pathfinder training.", "Try creating a full day's fleet allocation plan yourself using Pathfinder.", "Do not post practice screens in Hearth."]}

{"translations": ["You don't need to write long reports.", "Once you finish all the stepping stones, you will start actual work from the second week.", "Your first actual task is to receive a code review with 엄서진 님."]}
{"translations": ["The code review results will be shared in the Modakbul team channel."]}
{"translations": ["If you have any questions, feel free to contact Manager Junho Byeon at any time.", "Lastly, just leave a one-line impression on Modakbul and you're all set."]}

translations.10: You will eat lunch with your team members
translations.12: On the second day, you will spend the entire day on-site.
translations.13: You will observe the unloading process while wearing safety shoes.
translations.14: Do not speak to drivers while they are working first.
translations.15: Submit the experience report to the team leader for approval.
translations.16: Once confirmed, it will be delivered to Manager Junho Jun.
translations.18: MoaLogis new hires proceed through a task list called 'Launchpad' during their first week.
translations.19: Launchpad Task 1 is wiki login and joining the internal messenger.
translations.20: Company-wide announcements and small talk take place in the 'Hearth' channel.
translations.21: Leave a short self-introduction in Hearth.
translations.22: Step 2 is attending the fleet allocation system Pathfinder training.
translations.23: Try creating a full day's fleet allocation plan yourself using Pathfinder.
translations.24: Do not post practice screens in Hearth.
translations.25: You don't need to write long reports.
translations.26: Once you finish all the stepping stones, you will start actual work from the second week.
translations.27: Your first actual task is to receive a code review with 엄서진 님.
translations.28: The code review results will be shared in the Modakbul team channel.
translations.29: If you have any questions, feel free to contact Manager Junho Byeon at any time.
